messages.content: I’m starting the Cleveland March site visit: Mar. 2-4 from Chicago. Tuesday late afternoon at the downtown library partnership, Wednesday morning mural walk in Ohio City, Thursday debrief near University Circle ending around noon. Can you compare flight versus train versus driving and pair that with a hotel base? I’d rather not rent a car if it’s workable.
Absolutely. Before I price it: are you aiming to arrive Tuesday same day, and do you have a nightly lodging cap or refundable-only rule for this one?

Tuesday same-day is preferred. Try to keep the room near our travel rate, ideally under about $180 before tax. Refundable if the difference isn't silly. Breakfast helps; I also want to know if the room has coffee and a mini-fridge.

Here is the clean comparison: Option | Travel | Hotel base | Est. all-in | Timing | Trade-off. 1 | United ORD-CLE Tue 10:15a-12:35p, Thu 2:55p-3:25p | Downtown Holiday Inn Express or Hampton | about $590-$650 flight+2 hotel nights | easy bag drop before downtown meeting; airport return after noon debrief | best balance, no car. 2 | American ORD-CLE Tue 12:05p-2:22p, Thu 4:05p-4:35p | Downtown | about $540-$600 | cheaper, but tight Tuesday if the library meeting starts before 4:30 | less margin. 3 | Amtrak overnight Mon night/Tue early plus awkward return | Downtown | about $430 coach+hotel, more if sleeper | arrives very early; return times are poor | cheapest only if sleep disruption is acceptable. 4 | Drive | University Circle or downtown | about $430-$520 including gas, parking, hotel | 5.5-6 hours each way | flexible but eats most of Tuesday and Thursday.
That makes the train look less attractive. For the hotel base, what's the practical difference between downtown and University Circle?

Downtown wins for the first two touchpoints: walk or short ride to the Tuesday library meeting, then a 10-12 minute rideshare or Red Line hop toward Ohio City Wednesday. Thursday would be 20-25 minutes by HealthLine or 15-20 by rideshare to University Circle. University Circle makes Thursday easy but adds cross-town trips Tuesday and Wednesday, so it is less efficient unless the debrief becomes very early.
Please compare two or three actual hotel candidates. Nothing fancy; I care about total and avoiding car hassle.

Shortlist: Hotel | Area | Est. refundable total for Mar. 2-4 | Breakfast/room basics | Dining/transit | Catch. Holiday Inn Express Cleveland Downtown | Downtown | about $365-$395 | breakfast included; in-room coffee; mini-fridge commonly listed, confirm room type | easy walk to library, restaurants, Tower City/RTA nearby | older building, ask for quiet upper floor. Hampton Inn Cleveland-Downtown | Downtown | about $390-$430 | breakfast included; coffee; mini-fridge listed in many rooms | very practical for library and quick food | slightly higher. Courtyard University Circle | University Circle | about $410-$455 | coffee and mini-fridge; breakfast usually extra | best for Thursday debrief, museum-area restaurants | more rideshares Tue/Wed.
If I pick downtown, can I still get to the Thursday debrief without cutting it close for the 2:55 United?

Yes, if the debrief truly ends around noon. Leave University Circle at 12:10-12:20, rideshare to CLE is usually 25-35 minutes, and you should be at the terminal around 12:45-12:55 for a 2:55 flight. The RTA option works but is slower; I would use rideshare from the debrief straight to the airport with your bag.
Right, luggage. Would I need to store my bag at the hotel then go back?

Better not. On Thursday, check out, take your bag to the debrief, or ask the host if there is office storage. Going downtown after the debrief would add 35-45 minutes and make the afternoon flight less comfortable.
Can you price the United versus American with the downtown Holiday Inn Express? I want to see if the timing is worth paying for.

Pairing | Flight total | Hotel est. total | Trip total | Door-to-door fit. United + Holiday Inn Express | about $238 | $380 | $618 | arrive hotel around 1:20 Tuesday; depart CLE 2:55 Thursday; strongest margins. American + Holiday Inn Express | about $176 | $380 | $556 | arrive hotel around 3:05 Tuesday if on time; return 4:05 Thursday; saves about $62 but compresses Tuesday and gets you home later. Driving + Holiday Inn Express | gas/parking about $150-$190 | $380 plus any hotel parking | $530-$570 | lower cash cost, much more time, and downtown parking friction.
For $62, I don't think American is worth the Tuesday risk. Is the Holiday Inn Express a safe pick amenities-wise, or is Hampton cleaner for reimbursement?

Both are straightforward for reimbursement. Holiday Inn Express is the value pick if its refundable rate is real: breakfast included, simple receipt, central location. Hampton is a little more predictable on the room basics and may be quieter, but at $25-$35 more total I would only move to Hampton if Holiday Inn cannot confirm the mini-fridge or has a stricter cancellation deadline.
Can you check whether there are nearby dinner options if I arrive downtown Tuesday without a car?

Yes. From either downtown option you would have several walkable choices around East 4th, Euclid, and Playhouse Square, plus quick-service options near the Arcade and Tower City area. I would not choose University Circle just for dinner; downtown is easier that evening.

Okay. Use downtown as the base. Please hold Holiday Inn Express if it is refundable under $400 total; otherwise Hampton under $430. One bed is fine, quiet room if possible, and please verify the coffee/fridge.

I’ll use that order: first Holiday Inn Express Cleveland Downtown, Mar. 2-4, refundable, target under $400 total; backup Hampton Inn Cleveland-Downtown under $430. Notes: one-bed non-smoking room, quiet upper-floor request if available, confirm in-room coffee maker and mini-fridge, breakfast included, itemized folio at checkout.
And for flights, don’t ticket until I confirm the debrief end time, but pencil in United?

Yes. Working flight plan is United ORD-CLE Tue Mar. 2 around 10:15a-12:35p and CLE-ORD Thu Mar. 4 around 2:55p-3:25p, estimated $238, economy, no rental car. Hold the hotel now if the cancellation terms fit; ticket United after the Thursday noon end time is confirmed.
